note.en: Floor vote: Passed as amended by Conference Committee Report. The staff analysis says the bill helps charter school operators: “The bill authorizes a school of hope to co-locate with another public school in any facility.”. Donors listed are charter school operators, as their names and reported occupations appear in the campaign finance reports; this does not claim they asked for the bill or for this vote. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2025-203).
note.es: Votación en el pleno. El análisis del personal dice que el proyecto beneficia a operadores de escuelas chárter (cita en inglés): “The bill authorizes a school of hope to co-locate with another public school in any facility.”. Los donantes que aparecen son operadores de escuelas chárter, según sus nombres y ocupaciones en los reportes de campaña; esto no afirma que pidieran el proyecto ni este voto. Las donaciones se muestran con las fechas registradas, incluso las posteriores al voto. El proyecto se convirtió en ley (Ch. 2025-203).
note.ht: Vòt nan sesyon plenyè. Analiz anplwaye a di pwojè a ede operatè lekòl chatè (sitasyon an angle): “The bill authorizes a school of hope to co-locate with another public school in any facility.”. Donatè ki parèt yo se operatè lekòl chatè, jan non yo ak okipasyon yo parèt nan rapò kanpay yo; sa pa di yo te mande pwojè lwa a ni vòt sa a. Kado yo parèt ak dat yo anrejistre, menm sa ki vini apre vòt la. Pwojè a te tounen lwa (Ch. 2025-203).

note.en: Floor vote: third reading. The staff analysis says the bill helps craft brewers: “The bill may have a positive impact on craft brewers and brewpubs, who may pay less in brand and label fees to the ABT.”. Donors listed are craft brewers, as their names and reported occupations appear in the campaign finance reports; this does not claim they asked for the bill or for this vote. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2023-294).
note.es: Votación en el pleno. El análisis del personal dice que el proyecto beneficia a cervecerías artesanales (cita en inglés): “The bill may have a positive impact on craft brewers and brewpubs, who may pay less in brand and label fees to the ABT.”. Los donantes que aparecen son cervecerías artesanales, según sus nombres y ocupaciones en los reportes de campaña; esto no afirma que pidieran el proyecto ni este voto. Las donaciones se muestran con las fechas registradas, incluso las posteriores al voto. El proyecto se convirtió en ley (Ch. 2023-294).
note.ht: Vòt nan sesyon plenyè. Analiz anplwaye a di pwojè a ede bravri atizanal (sitasyon an angle): “The bill may have a positive impact on craft brewers and brewpubs, who may pay less in brand and label fees to the ABT.”. Donatè ki parèt yo se bravri atizanal, jan non yo ak okipasyon yo parèt nan rapò kanpay yo; sa pa di yo te mande pwojè lwa a ni vòt sa a. Kado yo parèt ak dat yo anrejistre, menm sa ki vini apre vòt la. Pwojè a te tounen lwa (Ch. 2023-294).
